description: Skelet G09b-02 AnalysisRun job lifecycle foundation

compatibility.instructions: Could the 009 migration, build-kit service, ledger-list updates, or CI test-list additions regress any existing contract, migration ordering, quota/billing semantics, or CI job?

correctness.instructions: Any missing required job state, wrong transition permission, unenforced precondition (completed without artifacts, failed without classification, canceled resurrection, retry over budget, resume from corrupt checkpoint, expiry before retention), quota double-charge or leak, or test/implementation mismatch?

evidence.instructions: Are the 22 PGlite tests plus 5 real-PostgreSQL concurrency tests sufficient for the full transition matrix, idempotency replay/conflict, cross-tenant isolation, lease fencing, cancel/retry/resume/expire races, quota exhaustion/rollback, and migration reversibility?

reliability.instructions: Any unhandled race (duplicate create, stale revision, lease preemption, cancel-versus-complete, retry-versus-expiry), nondeterministic identifier, or crash-recovery path that could publish success from invalid state?

scope.instructions: Anything beyond the job-lifecycle foundation: capture traversal, artifact generation, starter synthesis, REST/MCP/UI/CLI exposure, or frozen-contract modification?

security.instructions: Any cross-tenant read/mutation, identifier oracle, idempotency-key scope collision, quota bypass or negative balance, lease hijack, or secret/error leakage in the lifecycle?

state.change: G09b-02 AnalysisRun job lifecycle foundation against the frozen skelet.lens.build-kit.v1 contract: 009 migration (nine-state lens_build_kit_runs table with transition-guard trigger, per-workspace quota ledger), build-kit service (explicit nine-state matrix, tenant-scoped opaque deterministic identities, idempotent create with race-safe converge plus quota compensation, poll/cancel/retry/resume/expire operations, optimistic-concurrency revisions, worker leases with expiry preemption, atomic quota reservation/release, fail-closed cross-tenant errors), 22-test PGlite adversarial suite, 5-test real-PostgreSQL concurrency suite (duplicate-create converge, quota race, cancel-versus-complete determinism, crash recovery, reconnect durability), migration-ledger updates across 11 suites, CI db-foundation test-list additions. No capture, generation, network, or public API changes; frozen G09b-01 schema untouched.
